# POST /api/v1/orgs/{org}/repos

Create a repository in an organization

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-366`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `CreateRepoOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `name` | string | True | Required, AlphaDashDot, MaxSize(100) |
| `description` | string | False | MaxSize(2048) |
| `private` | bool | False |  |
| `auto_init` | bool | False |  |
| `gitignores` | string | False |  |
| `license` | string | False | MaxSize(100) |
| `readme` | string | False | MaxSize(255) |
| `default_branch` | string | False | GitRefName, MaxSize(100) |

## Response

**201** — Repository

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Repository ID |
| `name` | string | Repository name |

- **400** — Invalid readme template
- **403** — User not allowed to create repos in org
- **404** — Organization not found

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Repository creation applies ForcePrivate setting override | business_logic | setting.Repository.ForcePrivate is true |
| CreateUserRepo validates readme template exists when auto_init is true | validation | opt.AutoInit && len(opt.Readme) > 0 && readme not in available list |
| Org repo creation requires user to have create permission in org | authorization | User is not admin and cannot create org repo |

### Error Paths

- **Org not found** → prepareDoerCreateRepoInOrg → 404
- **User cannot create in org** → prepareDoerCreateRepoInOrg → 403
- **Repo already exists** → repo.CreateUserRepo → 409
